verdict.rationale: Numeral ships built-in, vendor-defined automations triggered by events: alerts when nexus is crossed in a new jurisdiction, autofile/autoregister, and automatic certificate validation with expiration and renewal tracking. Nothing in the evidence shows users can author their own rules or event-to-action triggers. Missing for 10: user-configurable rule or trigger definitions, webhooks or event subscriptions, custom action configuration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
